(MED 23)
Publication Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
AMENDMENT NO. 2 June 2021
TO
IS 17150 : 2019 MINI DOMESTIC WATER HEATER
FOR USE WITH PIPED NATURAL GAS ( PNG ) —
SPECIFICATION
(Page 2, clause 5.3) — Substitute the following for the existing clause:
‘Non-metallic materials normally in contact with the gas shall not change in
weight or volume by more than 15 percent after being immersed in pentane or
PNG for 72 h at room temperature, when tested according to Annex A.’
(Page 4, clause 18) — Substitute the following for the existing clause:
‘With the taps fully opened and with the burners operating at the maximum
consumption, the appliance shall give within ± 8 percent of the manufacturer’s
recommended gas consumption in l/h or heat input in kcal/h at 21 mbar
(21.41 gf/cm2) gas inlet pressure, the flow through the injector jet at 21 mbar
(21.41 gf/cm2) shall be measured with a wet gas meter using compressed air
(free from oil/impurities) and converted the same at STP (27°C and 100 kN/m2).
Thereafter using 1.43 as multiplying factor, the value of air flow at STP so
obtained to be converted to flow of PNG at STP.

NOTE:

1 For guidance 1 Litre = 0.001 cubic meter.

2 Compressed air shall be stored in a reservoir tank for 1 h between 25 to 30°C before starting
the test’.
